meta.name: firecrawl-map
meta.description: Discover and list all URLs on a website, with optional search filtering. Use this skill when the user wants to find a specific page on a large site, list all URLs, see the site structure, find where something is on a domain, or says "map the site", "find the URL for", "what pages are on", or "list all pages". Essential when the user knows which site but not which exact page.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出网站所有页面，快速定位目标链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从大网站中快速找到特定页面或了解站点结构。
copy.tagline_en: List all pages on a website to quickly find target URLs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find specific pages on large sites or understand site structure.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以列出网站的所有链接，还能用关键词搜索特定页面。
howto.when: 当你想找某个网站上的具体页面，或者想查看网站结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出 example.com 的所有页面。
在 docs.example.com 上搜索包含“auth”的页面。
say.note: Claude 会使用 --search 参数过滤结果。

say.text: 把 example.com 的链接保存到文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 -o 参数输出到文件。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can list all URLs on a website and optionally filter them by a search query.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to find a specific page on a large site, list all URLs, or see the site structure.

say_en.note: Claude will run firecrawl map to get all URLs.

say_en.text: Search for pages containing 'auth' on docs.example.com.
Save the URLs of example.com to a file.
say_en.note: Claude will use the -o option to output to a file.
